title: Bloby - Chrome Web Store
content_html:
Overview

Clippy on steroids

Meet Bloby—your adorable, floating AI sidekick living right inside your browser! Think of Clippy, but supercharged with modern AI, total local privacy, 100x more squishiness, and best of all—it's 100% free with absolutely zero ads! Whether you're shopping, reading, or navigating complex web apps, Bloby sits comfortably on your screen, ready to react to your clicks, execute voice commands, and browse the web for you hands-free. WHAT MAKES BLOBY SPECIAL? • 100% Free & Zero Ads: Enjoy a premium AI companion experience with zero cost, no hidden paywalls, and absolutely no annoying ads or ad-trackers. • Works Anywhere (99.99% Compatibility): From search engines to social networks and niche web apps, Bloby is tested and ready to run on virtually 99.99% of the websites you visit! • Always On, Always Cute: Bloby floats right on top of your browser. Drag it anywhere you like, click to chat, or just let it hang out with you while you browse. • Hands-Free Voice Controls: Skip typing and repetitive clicks. Simply speak your mind and watch Bloby interact with webpage elements instantly. • 100% Private & Local: Your data is nobody else's business. Bloby runs locally via on-device Chrome models and Ollama integration, meaning zero third-party tracking and complete data privacy. • Reactive Companion: Bloby isn't a static widget—it reacts playfully with cute animations whenever you click around or command it. VOICE COMMANDS YOU CAN USE Just click on Bloby, speak naturally, and let the magic happen: • "Click on the [element]" Example: "Click on the yellow icon" or "Click on the Submit button" Bloby finds the target on the page and clicks it for you. • "Set the [element] with the value [something]" Example: "Set the search input with the value mechanical keyboards" Fills out forms and text fields effortlessly. • "Get the [element] value" Example: "Get the price value" Reads out or retrieves specific content directly from the page. • "Search [something]" Example: "Search cute capybara videos" Instantly opens a new tab with your search request. • "Close window" Dismisses the current tab or window in a snap. UNDER THE HOOD & PERFORMANCE TIPS When you give Bloby a voice command, it uses local AI inference to read the page structure and find the right CSS selector: 1. On-Device Chrome LLM (Gemma 4): Fast, local intelligence powered right inside Google Chrome. 2. Local Ollama Integration: For precision target selection and complex web page elements. Hardware & Performance Note: Bloby delivers moderate, steady performance on macOS systems. If you're running a setup with an NVIDIA graphics card, local AI performance is drastically boosted for lightning-fast execution! QUICK SETUP INSTRUCTIONS (PREREQUISITES) To unlock Bloby's built-in Chrome AI capabilities, set up these two quick browser flags: 1. Open a new Chrome tab and go to: chrome://flags 2. Search for "Prompt API" and set it to Enabled. 3. Search for "Gemma 4 for Built-in AI" and set it to Enabled. 4. Relaunch Chrome when prompted. 5. Make sure your local Ollama server is running for enhanced selector accuracy! Ready for the ultimate free, ad-free, voice-controlled browser sidekick? Add Bloby to Chrome today and enjoy hands-free browsing with a smile!

content_html_zh:
概述

Clippy on steroids

Meet Bloby—your adorable, floating AI sidekick living right inside your browser! Think of Clippy, but supercharged with modern AI, total local privacy, 100x more squishiness, and best of all—it's 100% free with absolutely zero ads! Whether you're shopping, reading, or navigating complex web apps, Bloby sits comfortably on your screen, ready to react to your clicks, execute voice commands, and browse the web for you hands-free. WHAT MAKES BLOBY SPECIAL? • 100% Free & Zero Ads: Enjoy a premium AI companion experience with zero cost, no hidden paywalls, and absolutely no annoying ads or ad-trackers. • Works Anywhere (99.99% Compatibility): From search engines to social networks and niche web apps, Bloby is tested and ready to run on virtually 99.99% of the websites you visit! • Always On, Always Cute: Bloby floats right on top of your browser. Drag it anywhere you like, click to chat, or just let it hang out with you while you browse. • Hands-Free Voice Controls: Skip typing and repetitive clicks. Simply speak your mind and watch Bloby interact with webpage elements instantly. • 100% Private & Local: Your data is nobody else's business. Bloby runs locally via on-device Chrome models and Ollama integration, meaning zero third-party tracking and complete data privacy. • Reactive Companion: Bloby isn't a static widget—it reacts playfully with cute animations whenever you click around or command it. VOICE COMMANDS YOU CAN USE Just click on Bloby, speak naturally, and let the magic happen: • "Click on the [element]" Example: "Click on the yellow icon" or "Click on the Submit button" Bloby finds the target on the page and clicks it for you. • "Set the [element] with the value [something]" Example: "Set the search input with the value mechanical keyboards" Fills out forms and text fields effortlessly. • "Get the [element] value" Example: "Get the price value" Reads out or retrieves specific content directly from the page. • "Search [something]" Example: "Search cute capybara videos" Instantly opens a new tab with your search request. • "Close window" Dismisses the current tab or window in a snap. UNDER THE HOOD & PERFORMANCE TIPS When you give Bloby a voice command, it uses local AI inference to read the page structure and find the right CSS selector: 1. On-Device Chrome LLM (Gemma 4): Fast, local intelligence powered right inside Google Chrome. 2. Local Ollama Integration: For precision target selection and complex web page elements. Hardware & Performance Note: Bloby delivers moderate, steady performance on macOS systems. If you're running a setup with an NVIDIA graphics card, local AI performance is drastically boosted for lightning-fast execution! QUICK SETUP INSTRUCTIONS (PREREQUISITES) To unlock Bloby's built-in Chrome AI capabilities, set up these two quick browser flags: 1. Open a new Chrome tab and go to: chrome://flags 2. Search for "Prompt API" and set it to Enabled. 3. Search for "Gemma 4 for Built-in AI" and set it to Enabled. 4. Relaunch Chrome when prompted. 5. Make sure your local Ollama server is running for enhanced selector accuracy! Ready for the ultimate free, ad-free, voice-controlled browser sidekick? Add Bloby to Chrome today and enjoy hands-free browsing with a smile!
